observe.title: What to observe
observe.resample: Resample mode changes speed and pitch together; watch the spectrogram shift vertically.
observe.timeStretch: Time-stretch changes duration while the harmonic peaks stay put; the phase vocoder may smear transients.
observe.reverse: Reverse plays the result backwards; the magnitude spectrum is unchanged, the phase is not.

alias.title: Aliasing demo (no file needed)
alias.description: A sine is sampled at 48 kHz, then resampled to the target rate. With the anti-alias filter off, energy above the new Nyquist folds back to a lower frequency.

error.failed: The sampling process failed. Try a shorter range or another rate.

status.idle: Adjust a control to process the preview.

metrics.psnrNote: PSNR peak = 1.0 (full scale of the normalized float signal).
metrics.theoryNote: The theoretical 6.02·N + 1.76 dB assumes a full-scale sine and no dither.

observe.title: What to observe
observe.aliasing: Turn the anti-alias filter off and lower the target rate: a tone above the new Nyquist appears at a different frequency.
observe.dither: At low bit depth, dither replaces correlated quantization distortion with a steady noise floor.
observe.snr: Each extra bit adds about 6 dB of SNR; compare the measured value with the theoretical line.

error.tooLong: The result would exceed the 300 s processed-playback cap.
error.failed: The extent operation failed. Try a shorter range or different parameters.

waveform.beforeAria: Source waveform before the extent operation
waveform.afterAria: Result waveform after the extent operation

observe.title: What to observe
observe.truncate: A shorter truncation widens the main lobe and raises the bin width Δf = fs / N.
observe.zeroPad: Zero-padding adds no new information: it samples the same spectrum more densely, so the main-lobe width stays the same.
observe.tradeoff: A signal that is narrow in time is wide in frequency (time–bandwidth uncertainty).
observe.scale: Time scaling moves the spectrum inversely: x(at) has spectrum |a|⁻¹ X(f/a).
observe.periodic: Periodic extension produces spectral lines at multiples of 1/T.
observe.scaleNote: Time scaling deliberately has no anti-alias filter. For the filtered comparison, use the sampling lab (F03).
observe.units: Energy and average power are amplitude-squared values; for normalized audio in [−1, 1] the unit is full-scale².
